target.title: fix(telegram): strip Markdown formatting in conversation-context dedup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

**Issue #102257:** Telegram conversation-context dedup fails when the session transcript uses Markdown but the Telegram Bot API cache stores stripped plain text. `resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey` compares Markdown-rendered text against HTML-stripped Telegram `Message.text`, producing mismatched dedup keys and injecting duplicate assistant rows into the prompt context.

## Why This Change Was Made

The dedup key uses `stripMarkdown(stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(...)).trim()` so both the session transcript and Telegram cache text normalize to the same visible string. Without this fix, a Markdown-formatted message like `**bold**` produces key `bold` from the session but the cache stores literal `**bold**` — never matching → duplicate rows in every follow-up turn.

Additionally, the original fence regex `/```[^\n]*\n?([\s\S]*?)```/g` incorrectly matched inline triple-backtick sequences like ```literal``` in running text. The fix uses `(?<=^|\n)` lookbehind to require fences at line start and a mandatory trailing `\n` before the closing marker.

## User Impact

Without this fix: every conversation turn that includes Markdown-formatted assistant output injects duplicate rows into the prompt, progressively wasting context window and degrading response quality over long conversations.

Without the fence regex fix: `stripMarkdown` would incorrectly strip inline triple-backtick sequences in non-fence contexts (e.g., documentation mentioning ```code```).

## Evidence

**All 33 tests pass across all test files (6 follow-up + 12 gateway-verification + 15 unit):**

```
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  33 passed (33)
```

**8 TTS prepare-text tests pass (2 shared regression tests added for literal triple backticks/tildes):**

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
```

**25 LINE markdown-to-line tests pass (unchanged):**

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  25 passed (25)
```

### Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/shared/text/strip-markdown.ts` | Fence regex: require line-start (lookbehind) and mandatory trailing newline before fence close |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts` | Add `stripMarkdown` + `stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery` in dedup key |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch.ts` | Same normalization in timestamp-matching path |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.prompt-context-dedup.test.ts` | 15 unit tests for edge cases |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.gateway-verification.test.ts` | 12 P1 gateway verification tests (both paths) |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.gateway-followup.test.ts` | 6 full pipeline dedup tests |
| `src/tts/prepare-text.test.ts` | 2 shared regression tests for literal triple backtick/tilde |

### Fence regex change

**Before** (matched inline ```literal```):
```typescript
result = result.replace(/```[^\n]*\n?([\s\S]*?)```/g, "$1");
result = result.replace(/~~~[^\n]*\n?([\s\S]*?)~~~/g, "$1");
```

**After** (requires line-start fences):
```typescript
result = result.replace(/(?<=^|\n)[ \t]*```[^\n]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n[ \t]*```/g, "$1");
result = result.replace(/(?<=^|\n)[ \t]*~~~[^\n]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n[ \t]*~~~/g, "$1");
```
